patterns.message: The e2e is a black box: it starts each project with its start command and never imports its code.

eslint/no-restricted-properties.message: No branch for a platform: stop a started project with tree-kill, which stops the whole tree on each platform.

vitest/no-restricted-vi-methods.mock: A test never replaces a module: it gets the disk, the database, the network or the process as an argument, with a fake (vi.fn).
